calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH per AS (
  SELECT member_id,
    sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows,
    sum(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_rows,
    sum(CASE WHEN valid_from<=DATE '2026-10-08' AND valid_to>=DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS asof_rows,
    count(*) AS n
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT cur_rows, open_rows, asof_rows, count(*) AS members FROM per GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'dim_member' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_key) keys, count(DISTINCT member_id) ids, max(valid_from) mx FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_member_updates', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_key), count(DISTINCT member_id), max(valid_from) FROM stg_member_updates
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_in_dim_by_key', count(*), 0, 0, NULL FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)

SELECT 
 sum(CASE WHEN s.tier<>d.tier OR s.is_current<>d.is_current OR s.valid_from<>d.valid_from OR s.valid_to<>d.valid_to OR s.member_id<>d.member_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND join_date > DATE '2026-10-08') AS gold_future_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL) AS odd_tier,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND valid_from > DATE '2026-10-08') AS gold_after_request
FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)

SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold'
GROUP BY tier
